urdu: پنجاب اسمبلی میں جنرل نشستیں اور مخصوص نشستیں کیسے تقسیم کی جاتی ہیں؟
english: How are general seats and reserved seats distributed in the Punjab Assembly?
roman_1: Punjab assembly mein general nishteyn aur makhsoos nishteyn kesay taqseem ki jati hain?
roman_2: Punjab assembly main general nishtein aur makhsoos nishtein kaise taqseem ki jati hain?
roman_3: Punjab assembly may general nishteyn aur makhsoos nishteyn kis tarah taqseem ki jati hain?
